searchText: How can there be an eth book that has to be bought off chain 😞 you can buy it on chain Big announcement from our side just now. It’s time to decentralise the Beacon Chain and this is how we intend to do it... StakeWise is going permissionless, with no collateral requirements for operators. Oh, and Solo Stakers will be able to benefit from liquid staking too 🙌 The twitter announcement is here, which links to the medium post, a short explainer video and the full litepaper: https://twitter.com/stakewise_io/status/1575487080008130562 well "4" is a bit reductive 4 entities are Coinbase, Kraken, Binance and Lido ofc. On the operator level, you have 10 node operators controlling over 50% of the network right now. Things need to change lido is problematic but yeah it's not an singular party, 10 > 4 the point continues being valid even if it were 100
